prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1093; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with a cervical strain. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior history of injury or complaints involving the cervical region is known to this provider.

Care consisted of a total of 20 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate billing.

At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recurred or worsened.
